findings.current: साथ-साथ काम कहें, तो उप-एजेंट बँट जाते हैं
findings.problem: Calque. Hindi कहना does not take काम as its object in the sense 'ask for work'; a reader gets 'say work together'. The living phrasings are काम माँगें or काम के लिए कहें. The second independent reader reached the same diagnosis and the same replacement, but graded it MINOR; this verdict follows the task rubric, where an unidiomatic rendering is MAJOR.
findings.replacement: साथ-साथ काम माँगें, तो उप-एजेंट बँट जाते हैं
findings.evidence: CoreText/AppKit, system font, meta 12/500: current 203.9 pt, replacement 204.8 pt, against the tip's 270 pt text box (288 pt row at 320 pt minus the Info glyph 12 pt and its 6 pt gap). 26 characters against TIP_CHAR_BUDGET 48. Only the verb changes; उप-एजेंट and बँट जाते हैं are already the style guide's terms.

findings.current: कतार के संदेश भेजने के लिए फिर कोशिश करें
findings.problem: One instruction, two forms in one product: core's shipped Hindi (and the mobile mirror of it) says फिर से कोशिश करें — relay.health.ended_send_failed '…फिर से कोशिश करें…' — and the hi style guide writes फिर से शुरू करें, while this and four sibling keys drop से. relay.health.ended_send_failed ships in this app (byte-identical to core) and is one of the strings a reader meets on the same session surfaces.
findings.replacement: कतार के संदेश भेजने के लिए फिर से कोशिश करें
findings.evidence: Measured 248.0 pt at body-sm 14/400 (was 234.7) inside the 288 pt content column; the row wraps if it must, nothing is clamped.

findings.problem: जगाना is obligatorily transitive and the English object ('me') is dropped, so the chip asks the reader to 'wake' with no one woken. Every other chip in the pool has its object or is intransitive, so this one is the odd member rather than a terse convention.
findings.evidence: Measured 131.3 pt at body-sm 14/400 (was 108.2) in the 256 pt chip text box; 24 characters, the source locale's own chip budget.

findings.problem: Optional. इस्तेमाल करना normally takes the genitive object (विकल्पों का इस्तेमाल); the dropped का is tolerated in terse UI Hindi. The second independent reader judged the current form natural and asked for no change; kept as a NIT so the choice is visible rather than silently made.
findings.evidence: Measured 161.3 pt at label 15/600 (was 128.9); the button sizes to its label.

cross_namespace_observations.owner: mobile.schedules audit hi30s1 (a different auditor; not this group)
cross_namespace_observations.why: Intl.PluralRules('hi').select(0) === 'one', so zero takes the singular arm; the sentence actually rendered at zero is '0 जागृति', where Hindi reads the plural after zero ('0 जागृतियाँ'), as it does for 2 and 21. The style guide's own example ('0 फ़ाइल is singular') is where this comes from and is the thing to correct.
cross_namespace_observations.exact_fix: mobile.schedules.count.wakes → {count, plural, =0 {# जागृतियाँ} one {# जागृति} other {# जागृतियाँ}}; mobile.schedules.show_more.wakes → {hidden, plural, =0 {# और जागृतियाँ दिखाएँ} one {# और जागृति दिखाएँ} other {# और जागृतियाँ दिखाएँ}}
cross_namespace_observations.disposition: filed by that namespace's owner as HI-B-5 at severity minor in i18n/audits/evidence/hi/mobile.schedules/hi30s1. Recorded here as independent corroboration with the same fix; this auditor would grade it MAJOR (the rendered zero phrase is not idiomatic Hindi), but the schedules auditor owns the disposition.

cross_namespace_observations.owner: mobile.schedules audit hi30s1 (a different auditor; not this group)
cross_namespace_observations.what: oblique counted noun after a numeral
cross_namespace_observations.current: {family, select, wakes {जागृतियाँ} other {मॉनिटर}} वाली कुल {total} बातचीत में से {shown} दिखा रहे हैं।
cross_namespace_observations.rendered_here: … वाली कुल 2 बातचीत में से 2 दिखा रहे हैं।
cross_namespace_observations.why: बातचीत sits after a numeral and before में से, so it needs the oblique plural (बातचीतों); the family noun before वाली likewise takes the oblique (जागृतियों / मॉनिटरों).
cross_namespace_observations.disposition: filed by that namespace's owner as HI-B-1 at severity major in i18n/audits/evidence/hi/mobile.schedules/hi30s1, with the same substantive fix. No duplicate finding is filed here.

cross_namespace_observations.what: count nouns that are invariant in the direct plural
cross_namespace_observations.rendered_here: 0 सत्र · 1 सत्र · 2 सत्र · 21 सत्र   and   0 मॉनिटर · 1 मॉनिटर · 2 मॉनिटर · 21 मॉनिटर
cross_namespace_observations.why: सत्र and मॉनिटर have no distinct direct plural, so the CLDR one-for-zero selection produces a correct phrase in these two; only जागृति (जागृतियाँ) exposes the defect. This is why the zero case is observable on two keys and not five.
